# Synthetic fixtures

These files are SYNTHETIC. Every value is made up; codes are `FAKE-nnnn` / `PMR-nnnnn` and patient IDs are `PT-FAKE-nnnnn`. Drug names are realistic in format only.

Generated by `tests/make_fixtures.py` (fixed seed). Do not edit by hand: re-run `python tests/make_fixtures.py`. A test fails if these files drift from the script.

Headers are placeholders chosen for the fixtures; they are not real OmniCell or PMR headers. The baseline robot files deliberately use different header styles, so the `same_headers` check is expected to raise on that pair.

Days of cover for the baseline items (stock / (dispensed / 90)) are in the comments beside `ITEMS` in the script, for hand-checking later milestones.

## Baseline (clean) files

| File | Notes |
|------|-------|
| `omnicell_robot_1.csv` | Baseline. Title Case headers with stray spaces, items 1-6, ISO expiry dates, UTF-8 (includes a micro sign). |
| `omnicell_robot_2.csv` | Baseline. Mixed case / UPPER_SNAKE headers, items 7-12, no expiry column, abbreviated names (Tabs, Inj, Soln). |
| `omnicell_activity.csv` | Baseline. Robot activity statistics in the real shape: ';' delimiter, dd.mm.yy dates, newest first, 31 days to 19.10.26, one system (Medimat1), quiet weekends. |
| `pmr_usage.csv` | Baseline. snake_case headers, items 1-12, 90 days to 19/10/2026, dd/mm/yyyy dates, names in other forms (0.5g vs 500mg, Amox, pack sizes differ) and a fake `Patient ID` column that must be dropped. |

## Planted problems

| File | Problem | Expected check that catches it |
|------|---------|--------------------------------|
| `omnicell_robot_1__missing_required_column.csv` | Required column missing (stock quantity column removed) | required_columns: names `stock_qty` and stops |
| `omnicell_robot_1__duplicate_rows.csv` | Exact duplicate row, and a second row with the same key but a different quantity | duplicates: keyed on (robot_id, item_code or name) |
| `omnicell_robot_1__negative_qty.csv` | One negative and one blank stock quantity | negative_or_missing_qty: 2 affected rows |
| `omnicell_robot_1__unit_mismatch.csv` | Paracetamol held as Unit=Box, Pack Size=1; PMR counts it in tablets | unit_mismatch: robot vs PMR unit/pack size |
| `omnicell_robot_1__item_not_in_pmr.csv` | Item in a robot export but not in PMR (also zero usage by absence) | match: level 4 review list; analyse: dead stock / stock not in PMR |
| `omnicell_robot_1__cp1252.csv` | Saved as Windows-1252 (micro sign is byte 0xB5, invalid UTF-8) | encoding: UTF-8 fails, falls back to Windows-1252 and reports it |
| `omnicell_robot_1__utf8_bom.csv` | UTF-8 with a byte-order mark (first header would otherwise read as \ufeffItem Code) | encoding: BOM stripped, header still maps to item_code |
| `omnicell_robot_2__item_in_both_robots.csv` | Levothyroxine stocked in robot 1 and robot 2 | match/analyse: summed under combined_per_branch, separate under per_robot |
| `omnicell_robot_2__same_headers_as_robot_1.csv` | Robot 2 content in robot 1 header style (the passing case) | same_headers: no warning; the baseline pair differs and raises it |
| `pmr_usage__item_not_in_robots.csv` | Warfarin dispensed in PMR but stocked in neither robot | match: level 4 review list (PMR side) |
| `pmr_usage__zero_usage_item.csv` | Amoxicillin rows all have quantity 0 (stocked, zero usage) | analyse: dead stock, no division by zero |
| `pmr_usage__short_range.csv` | PMR covers only the last 30 days, period is 90 | pmr_date_range: warns that the range is shorter than period_days |
| `pmr_usage__missing_branch.csv` | Five rows have a blank branch | branch_present: 5 affected rows |
| `pmr_usage__negative_qty.csv` | One negative dispensed quantity (a return) | negative_or_missing_qty: 1 affected row |
| `omnicell_robot_1__bestand_format.csv` | Real OmniCell stock listing shape: ';' delimiter, 61 columns, copy columns, blank STRENGTH, placeholder expiry dates, one drug under two barcodes, a name over 50 characters | load: delimiter ';', type omnicell_stock; ARTIKELCODE/NAME/PACKSIZE/ISTANZAHL map, copies and expiry placeholder ignored; no duplicates flagged |
| `omnicell_activity__pull_2.csv` | A later pull: 21 days up to 21.10.26, with 19.10.26 and 16.10.26 revised | merge: latest pull wins; 3 changed counts on 2 days reported |
| `omnicell_activity__shuffled_columns.csv` | Columns in a different order (as in the real files) | load: columns map by name, same result as the baseline |
| `omnicell_activity__missing_day.csv` | A weekday (16.10.26) is missing from the middle of the range | missing_days: 1 day missing |
| `omnicell_activity__duplicate_days.csv` | 19.10.26 repeated, and 16.10.26 repeated with a different count | duplicates: 2 days, 1 with different counts |
| `omnicell_activity__period_not_24.csv` | One row covers a 12-hour period | period_hours: 1 affected row |
| `omnicell_activity__negative_count.csv` | One negative dispensed count and one blank stocked count | negative_or_missing_qty: 2 issues |
| `omnicell_activity__unknown_system.csv` | Two rows name a system (Medimat2) that is not in the robot registry | system_registry: branch unknown |
| `omnicell_activity__missing_required_column.csv` | Required column missing (DISPENSED removed) | required_columns: names `dispensed` and stops |
| `pmr_usage__grouped_report.csv` | Lowood PMR report layout: each script is a line plus a month/quantity line, directions wrapped onto extra lines, whole months only, Apr to Oct 2026 | load: flattened (layout grouped), Patient No. dropped, month dates; analyse: Jul-Sep window of 92 days, October left out as possibly incomplete |
| `pmr_usage__grouped_report_orphan_line.csv` | The grouped layout with one script line that never gets its month/quantity line | load: warning that 1 line did not fit the grouped layout |
| `pmr_usage__shared_codes.csv` | PMR product codes equal the robot item codes | match: level 1 exact code works when switched on |
